124119.synopsis:
There is always a character like this in novels—someone whose beauty could almost rival that of a true heartthrob, yet who is also s*upid, greedy, jealous, short-sighted, unambitious, and vain. After all, the original intention of their existence is to serve as a foil, highlighting the nobility and perfection of the real heartthrob by comparison. Eventually, they ended up losing everything—becoming nothing more than a pitiful, poor imitation of the main protagonist, one that is hated by all and cast aside.
Jiang Qingci was cast in exactly this kind of role: a low-quality heartthrob.
At first, the system had full confidence in him—knowing that Jiang Qingci was already stunning and charming to begin with, even before he got involved with all this transmigration business. And although he had attracted plenty of admirers, his poor character kept him from ever experiencing a single romantic relationship, not even up to the moment of his death. In every sense, he could almost be considered the perfect candidate for the role.
But what it didn’t know was that even up to the moment of his death, those who had once loved Jiang Qingci never stopped being infatuated with him, not even for a single moment.
• • • • •
 [Impostor] 
Jiang Qingci was the childhood friend of a heartthrob. 
The heartthrob was a kind man—someone who was saintly enough to save an injured young master who had fallen on hard times and to sober up a drunk CEO passed out in a bar. In contrast, Jiang Qingci was rotten to the core. Not only was he being kept by the heartthrob, but he was also living off the money the heartthrob earned from working eight different jobs—just so he could go out partying in clubs. On top of that, he even had the audacity to take credit for the heartthrob’s kindness, fooling both the CEO and the young master into thinking he was the one who had saved them, all while shamelessly basking in their affection without a shred of guilt.
That was until the truth was finally exposed. What was supposed to happen next was that the heartthrob would be completely disappointed in him, while the men Jiang Qingci had deceived would join forces to take revenge and crush him. In the end, he was meant to lose everything, freezing to death alone on the streets. 
But when his true face was finally revealed, what greeted him instead was the heartthrob’s dark, unreadable gaze. “A Ci… Whatever you want, I would have given it to you. But why… Why did you have to go and seduce those men?”
Panicked, Jiang Qingci tried to run away, but he only ended up crashing into the arms of other men. 
The deceived men caught him.
He hadn’t lost everything—except…
 [Artificial Merman] 
Jiang Qingci was an artificial merman created by the institute using real merfolk blood. In the lab, he was their most dazzling creation.
But when the institute captured a real mermaid, the comparison was almost unforgiving because when placed next to the beautiful, blue-violet creature, the fake merman suddenly seemed dull and ugly. And so, in a desperate attempt to win back the affection that he once held, he committed countless wrongs. He even went so far as to try setting the real mermaid free.
What he never expected was that the universally-adored mermaid, who should have found him repulsive for being artificially created, would actually take him back to his lair. The merman’s tail coiled tightly around him, insisting he become his mate. 
Not long after, the merfolk’s habitat would find itself surrounded by human warships, their crews demanding that they surrender humanity’s so-called treasure.
 [Calamity’s Immortal Lord] 
Jiang Qingci was the Immortal Lord who presided over calamity in the celestial realm. Wherever misfortune existed, his presence was never far behind. A general, teetering on the brink of death in a losing battle, once caught a glimpse of him on the battlefield. A young emperor, fleeing for his life, had also seen his figure in passing. But even so, no matter how chaotic the world became, Jiang Qingci was always clad in white robes—like a banished immortal, untouched by even the faintest trace of dust.
The general would eventually reclaim his territory, and the emperor would eventually regain his power, but neither of them would ever see Jiang Qingci again.
They were supposed to fall in love with the Immortal Lord of Fortune—not the one who presided over calamity. Jiang Qingci was meant to be treated with nothing but contempt. Yet after he disappeared, they went mad, desperately praying to the heavens to let him return to the mortal world, even if it meant being bound to misfortune for all eternity.
In the end, even the universally-adored Immortal Lord of Fortune clasped Jiang Qingci’s hands tightly and murmured, “Blessing and calamity have always been intertwined. That’s simply the way the world works. That’s why… you and I were always meant to be an inseparable pair.”
 [Stand-In Streamer] 
Jiang Qingci was a kept man. 
A mere stand-in for the CEO’s white moonlight, who was known for being breathtakingly beautiful, cold, and utterly untouchable. Everyone loved him, but no one could have him, so instead, they turned their attention to the little stand-in, who was greedy for power and money. At times, they would sometimes pause, captivated by how his face resembled that of their white moonlight, only for them to secretly look down on him again in their hearts for his inferior character.
However, they never expected that the little stand-in would actually start livestreaming a “stand-in” service. “A grenade gets you a single sentence in the White Moonlight’s tone. A rocket launcher earns you five. And a deep-sea bomb…” Jiang Qingci’s lips curled into a smile. “That makes you my boss. However you want me to be, that’s exactly what I’ll become.”
The CEO watching the stream instantly exploded with rage.
But when he rushed to the stand-in’s home to settle the score, he found that the very White Moonlight he had long yearned for was tightly gripping the stand-in’s wrist, gently coaxing him: “If you want to make money pretending to be me… why not stay by my side instead? I can show you every version of me there is.”
And as if one wasn’t enough, he soon had the current top celebrity, a famous e-sports star, and the CEO of a rival company all showing up at his door to settle accounts with him.
• • • • •
Seeing that there was no exception—whether it was the heartthrob or the top-tier male leads who were supposed to fall for the heartthrob—they all ultimately ended up falling in love with Jiang Qingci instead.
The system was utterly confused: “Did you even take the mission seriously? Why are they all falling for you?”
Jiang Qingci, dazed and breathless as he barely pulled himself away from another overwhelming kiss, blinked in confusion. “I don’t know either… How could this even happen?”
But even the system itself started acting strange.
From its initial cold indifference, it gradually changed—until one day, it could no longer suppress its voice and whispered in a low, restrained tone: “Don’t get close to those bad men. They will devour you.”
